customManagers.description: Versions in mise.toml's [env] marked with a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment on the line above

packageRules.description: One PR for all GitHub Actions bumps
kindest/node images belong to a kind release
prBodyNotes: Update `KIND_NODE_IMAGE` in `mise.toml` and the two node images in `lint-test.yaml` from this kind release's notes.

packageRules.description: Shyft image: `image.repository` and `image.tag` in the chart's values.yaml. Its tags (37.3.0-1.1) are not semver.
Shyft patch bump, same line: a chart patch release
prBodyNotes: Bump the chart's patch version, add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry and run `mise run docs`, or the `Chart` check fails.

packageRules.description: New Shyft line (major or minor): a chart minor release
prBodyNotes: New Shyft line. Bump the chart's minor version, set `appVersion` to `<major>.<minor>`, add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and run `mise run docs`.
